 Zeeshan Qureshi @ Zeeshan Quraishi ...Petitioner
 Versus

For the Petitioner : Ms. Sonal Sodhani, Advocate

For State : Mr. Shiv Shankar Kumar, Advocate  ---
04/16.04.2024 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned  counsel for the respondent State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Bharno P.S. Case No. 32 of 2023, for the offence registered under sections 414/420/34 of the Indian Penal Code, section 11(1)(d) of Animal Cruelty Act and Section 12(1) and 13(1) of Jharkhand Bovine Animals (Prohibition of Slaughter) Act, 2005, pending in the court of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Gumla.

entities.text: Jharkhand Bovine Animals (Prohibition of Slaughter) Act, 2005
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the truck was being driven by the driver and the petitioner is the owner of the truck and not present on the spot.
The petitioner has nothing to do with illegal carriage of the bovine animals.
4. Learned State counsel opposed the prayer on the ground that the bovine animals were being carried in the said truck.

5. Considering that the petitioner is the owner of the truck and he was not present at the spot and the said truck was being driven by the driver, I am inclined to provide privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

6. Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is hereby directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today, and in the event of his surrender/arrest, the petitioner, above named, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Gumla, in connection with Bharno P.S. Case No. 32 of 2023, subject to the Zeeshan Qureshi @ Zeeshan Quraishi vs The State Of Jharkhand ...
